report.answer_text:
Tianwen-2 is China’s first asteroid sample-return mission. It launched from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center on May 29, 2025, Beijing time, with two targets: one to sample and one to study up close. (cnsa.gov.cn)
1. 469219 Kamoʻoalewa (2016 HO₃) is a small near-Earth asteroid and a *quasi-satellite*: it stays near Earth as it orbits the Sun, but it is not a moon. Tianwen-2 reached it in July 2026. The plan is to collect surface material and deliver it to Earth in a capsule in late 2027. (english.www.gov.cn)
2. 311P/PANSTARRS is an active asteroid, often called a *main-belt comet*, that sheds dust and forms comet-like tails. After releasing the sample capsule, the spacecraft will continue to 311P to study it with onboard instruments, without collecting samples. (cnsa.gov.cn)

quotes.text: According to mission planners and scientists, Tianwen 2 will target 2016 HO3, the smallest and closest quasi-satellite to Earth.
The 2016 HO3, also known as 469219 Kamo'oalewa, was first spotted in April 2016 by an asteroid survey telescope at the Haleakala Observatories in Hawaii, the US.
